introduction: Meet the woodland folk, follow the forrestal’s leads and explore the elemental fragments and ether tower. Three independent offerings record accepted outcomes; the six-plaque treasure puzzle is a separate exploration route. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter from the animal path through the forest. The protector stands at the eastern entrance. Woodland fairies, sprites, brownies, koalas and the dryad have different leads. ASK a nearby person about one of their listed topics; a recognized reply can reveal that contact, without making every keyword a separate achievement.

Find the forrestal, who starts in the northwest maple grove and can wander. Ask groves, sprite, dark, rift, rowans and heal for the damaged-grove story. He accepts two exact keys for experience, or the cube of ethereal matter for a greenstone earring and experience. These are three independent deliveries; no earlier personal discussion or offering receipt is required.

The cloudy key starts on the ground in the maple grove, and the black key starts on the ground in the dogwood grove. Each fits a different upper tower door. Use the key for access before spending it on the forrestal if you want that route. A supplied key fits too; an already-open shared path does not prove your own unlocking.

The twisted rowan grove leads west into separate earth, water, fire and air fragments. Follow the sprites’ realm and sanctum clues. Each fragment has two different guardian keys and a sanctum route; the exact keys and doors differ. Combat, key recovery and travel are separate from the forrestal’s accepted deliveries.

Earth uses the gravel and slate keys; water uses seashell and coral; fire uses igneous and magma; air uses glass and crystal. The guardian equipment or carried stock supplies these keys when legitimately available. Current possession can prepare access, but does not prove a personal kill or first acquisition from its original source.

Water routes include deep water and underwater rooms; air routes include rooms without ground, and fire routes include fire-plane terrain. Native movement, breath, flight, levitation, mounts and hazards still apply. The blue seashell has a worn waterbreathing effect; the fairy-dust pouch explicitly does not grant flight. Neither item is a compulsory forrestal offering.

The four sanctums and the two upper tower rooms are the intended plaque branches. Five copies of the same runed pedestal and one black pedestal are closed display containers, without a lock. Open the display case and examine its actual contents. Available stock depends on what has already been recovered and whether the grove has renewed.

Climb the baobab to the ether tower. The five climbing rooms have different native fall settings, and the tower contains wombats and an ether wraith. The wraith’s equipment includes the actual cube of ethereal matter. It is an offering item, not a container you must open, and it appears before the final six-plaque treasure chamber.

The cloudy key fits the upper door from the northeastern tower corner to the ethereal sanctum; the black key fits the other upper door to the empty tower. Those rooms are intended to supply the cloudy and black plaques. Returning either key for experience consumes it, so a reward receipt cannot replace access stock.

The six plaque keys fit the northern corridor in this order: stone, silver, gold, crystal, cloudy, black. Each plaque carries part of the final riddle. The last elemental door answers to SAY nothing beside it; then OPEN it if closed. Speech ability and native shared door state matter. Reading, saying the word and opening a door do not currently create personal puzzle-completion receipts.

The final chamber holds a small black cube, a fixed closed container distinct from the ether wraith’s offering. Its reset children are a black wand and a jagged obsidian dagger. The dagger has its own combat effects. The room’s epic stone and memory trophy follow separate rules; none is an input to the forrestal’s three deliveries.

The enchanted valley can be reached through downward exits from the air route. Its lady has equipment and lore, without a native delivery contract. The northern archway returns to the winding path through the glades through an ordinary exit. The bubbling spring is an object with a DRINK spring effect, not a quest turn-in.

Returning the ethereal cube rewards the earring and experience, then retires that forrestal. His reply says he may heal the grove and will tell the dryad; the current contract does not restore rooms, escort anyone or record a personal rescue. The earring’s worn effect is protection from fire. Base experience amounts still follow native capped and frozen recipient reward rules.

These three deliveries are potential dailies only when the real giver and legitimate proof stock are available. Current stock and wandering or retired givers can limit availability; the journal does not guarantee renewed supplies. No new discovery, journal or completion credit is available without active, ready accounting.

stories.title: The forrestal: investigate the cloudy key
stories.summary: Offer the exact cloudy key for base 20,000 experience under native reward rules. He remains afterward. This consumes a key that also opens the cloudy upper tower room; it does not record opening that door or recovering a plaque.

steps.hint: The key’s floor source is the maple grove. It fits the upper door from the northeastern tower corner to the ethereal sanctum. Plan access before spending it. Carry the exact item loose. Held, worn, nested, spent or handed-away stock does not satisfy current preparation. Matching supplied proof fits without your own earlier source, access or delivery history.

steps.hint: Only an accepted delivery records this outcome. Current reward possession, speech, recovery and access are separate. New progress requires active, ready accounting.

stories.title: The forrestal: investigate the black key

stories.title: The forrestal: an otherworldly offering
stories.summary: Bring the cube of ethereal matter for a greenstone earring and base 200,000 experience under native reward rules. The forrestal leaves to tell the dryad. The accepted offering is recorded; actual grove restoration and rescue are not implemented outcomes.
